Did not search eBay (closed). Gowans picture: signed McHugh vases mostly $90-230 hammer, typical about $130-180 for good-size ones; small/damaged $25-60; outliers $350 and $1,510. This vase with foot chips and stated hairline likely at the lower-middle of the $90-180 band (rough guide $80-150 hammer).
viewing_check: Check the hairline (length, whether it runs through the wall; hold to light or tap for ring), size the foot chips, confirm height about 22cm and incised mark legibility. Look for restoration under UV or by touch.
